` [Highlight start] Taking magnesium and alcohol together is generally safe for most adults, but alcohol depletes magnesium and makes supplements less effective [Highlight end] ` . You can read more about [how magnesium and alcohol interact](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw) and potential absorption issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)

### How Alcohol Affects Magnesium

- **Increased urination:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic and affects kidney function, flushing magnesium out of the body through urine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXYC2Tw43qm5frlZr7KoSPY7GORxRrLEorRn0MY3VvV5O4xqoq0pQzzpN3-Qq4fQP9Jued4Y47jUIs17-qA4PeV1BEUPoA65Vq29a7kNRjq62LcDHCsnOKgLOWMsmXOWXs)
- **Reduced absorption:** Digestive irritation, vomiting, diarrhea, and poor diet tied to heavy drinking can lower how much magnesium your body absorbs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1-B71pQRCX-tnur5CUCI8uABTio6DS0mCr4uP8XOT1bCIP1Apdv5frBCA-_Bmu2fx_0PXgp1NKGae7km3FuLfMB6lwVsputgGhdeyjpDEdfeAq5nYTdm_7PJebuZZNDizLYLbEWcdJDxGlc5JQxK98eY6X4imC-UpqRRP6-2ulSFx992LlftVzKXVw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)
- **Common deficiency:** Low magnesium levels occur in about 30% to 60% of people who drink heavily or chronically.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1z6n8gsM8XfpntphcrgvlDPz_JyAFrxRSAzdDrxngfj_4ckOxidJVgVBjV0XwM_6mZ7P-sc-bHw-ptMlBSwTRqY1n8Ks5U2yahJ0SuLXhIi2ON3CXRcsJ_SCRTeN0rwdRiDruYf1NjV6qU3uQrz5fukMw5c2lM8h9-1QPXOEA_nWPRkp4rThaWTpWwWHSu2O0HmZVtOHok_d89VVZBwiBu0IL1e1Q2lHP3mo6_8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)

### Risks and Side Effects

- **Supplement side effects:** Combining magnesium supplements with alcohol—especially at high doses—can increase digestive side effects like nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)
- **Low magnesium symptoms:** Depleted levels can contribute to muscle cramps, weakness, fatigue, tremors, irritability, irregular heart rhythms, or low potassium and calcium.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1z6n8gsM8XfpntphcrgvlDPz_JyAFrxRSAzdDrxngfj_4ckOxidJVgVBjV0XwM_6mZ7P-sc-bHw-ptMlBSwTRqY1n8Ks5U2yahJ0SuLXhIi2ON3CXRcsJ_SCRTeN0rwdRiDruYf1NjV6qU3uQrz5fukMw5c2lM8h9-1QPXOEA_nWPRkp4rThaWTpWwWHSu2O0HmZVtOHok_d89VVZBwiBu0IL1e1Q2lHP3mo6_8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1-B71pQRCX-tnur5CUCI8uABTio6DS0mCr4uP8XOT1bCIP1Apdv5frBCA-_Bmu2fx_0PXgp1NKGae7km3FuLfMB6lwVsputgGhdeyjpDEdfeAq5nYTdm_7PJebuZZNDizLYLbEWcdJDxGlc5JQxK98eY6X4imC-UpqRRP6-2ulSFx992LlftVzKXVw)
- **Withdrawal complications:** Low magnesium can worsen central nervous system excitability and withdrawal symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqgEBxCJF196GFslsGtp5soSXyGPzaAfid9iwqaBhFsQ7NxzLGhY7vjv8E5tK0s_0iH4nzBniQ1yg36337Z9xwbl_PXRk4M6L4wddD3o8yM2j0w_1JXcFnKXbegGHNiZq22-gk_CjHtZm9TzJkNENcKIaOnd0cCQZDUXllUyPXXnNAsyhFs6Vp2HSVul9MOL42TwVpDJAJf2oJfSmRFqxaBLSlW0Int5u7ychhQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1z6n8gsM8XfpntphcrgvlDPz_JyAFrxRSAzdDrxngfj_4ckOxidJVgVBjV0XwM_6mZ7P-sc-bHw-ptMlBSwTRqY1n8Ks5U2yahJ0SuLXhIi2ON3CXRcsJ_SCRTeN0rwdRiDruYf1NjV6qU3uQrz5fukMw5c2lM8h9-1QPXOEA_nWPRkp4rThaWTpWwWHSu2O0HmZVtOHok_d89VVZBwiBu0IL1e1Q2lHP3mo6_8)

### Practical Takeaways

- **Space them out:** Taking magnesium separately from alcohol and limiting alcohol intake supports better absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXMv3C3LBlWhj7hM-yf0RQ3GFC5luo1cDRxs0LFKshVoxehHUPVnCkJ_FLO-o08chAXk0OCBihs_J5I7FRuK8tHwL2wfb6C4B95VHgxupd3zwBXMVSV8FNu_SjQSKdzI6eQYfUbcWQqtbN1BubsmWiaOnj72temJkU2fk)
- **Don't rely on it as a fix:** Magnesium will not prevent or reverse alcohol-related organ damage while drinking continues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)
- **Check with a clinician:** Ask a doctor or pharmacist before using magnesium supplements to address a deficiency, manage withdrawal, or pair with medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXcZfutgBctavOm7OkbHjt0iuc3POct77PDT_C4uHDD-McgbVdjCOuc3MS_Wf5uYlWFj1jqa9naaNAOKgATHRqRqJld-FuUCi3ZnrhrOy1R2xYd6eg0hJvwqFPWU9OnBGxcKohqbBJkvP6fc0w1GFZSPU6Fw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1z6n8gsM8XfpntphcrgvlDPz_JyAFrxRSAzdDrxngfj_4ckOxidJVgVBjV0XwM_6mZ7P-sc-bHw-ptMlBSwTRqY1n8Ks5U2yahJ0SuLXhIi2ON3CXRcsJ_SCRTeN0rwdRiDruYf1NjV6qU3uQrz5fukMw5c2lM8h9-1QPXOEA_nWPRkp4rThaWTpWwWHSu2O0HmZVtOHok_d89VVZBwiBu0IL1e1Q2lHP3mo6_8)
